summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K to disclose a transparency notification from Bank of America, which crossed above the 5% threshold for Lakefront voting rights on May 13, 2026. As of May 20, Bank of America owned 623,434 direct voting rights and 5,502,802 equivalent financial instruments, representing 9.30% of the 65,897,071 outstanding shares. This is a routine regulatory filing under Belgian transparency legislation, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or management change is implied. This filing is purely a pass-through of a passive ownership notification.
